'''Lusitânia Futebol Clube''' is a Portuguese [[association football|football]] club from [[Lourosa (Santa Maria da Feira)|Lourosa]] in [[Santa Maria da Feira]], [[Aveiro District]]. The club was founded in 1924 and competes in [[Liga Portugal 2]], the second tier of the [[Portuguese football league system]].

After winning the [[Terceira Divisão]] in 1973, the club reached the semi-finals of the [[Taça de Portugal]] in [[1993–94 Taça de Portugal|1993–94]]. They defeated [[G.D. Argus|Argus]], [[S.C. Praiense|Praiense]], [[Associação Académica de Coimbra – O.A.F.|Académica Coimbra]], [[S.C. Beira-Mar|Beira-Mar]], [[G.D. Chaves|Chaves]] and [[C.F. Os Belenenses|Belenenses]] to reach the semi-final, where they lost 6–0 away to [[Sporting CP|Sporting]] on 2 April 1994.<ref>{{cite news |title=Lourosa: cinco golos de Balakov travaram ida ao Jamor|trans-title=Lourosa: five goals from Balakov prevented a trip to Jamor |url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/lourosa-cinco-golos-de-balakov-travaram-ida-ao-jamor |access-date=3 September 2019 |publisher=Mais Futebol |date=28 March 2013 |language=pt}}</ref>"}}
